as each of the properties of the shorthand:
  • outline-width: medium

  • outline-color: auto
rows.label: 초기값
rows.text: as each of the properties of the shorthand: outline-width: medium outline-style: none outline-color: auto

rows.html:
as each of the properties of the shorthand:
  • outline-width: the absolute <length>, snapped as a line width
  • outline-style: as specified
  • outline-color: For the keyword auto, the computed value is currentcolor. For the color value, if the value is translucent, the computed value will be the rgba() corresponding one. If it isn't, it will be the rgb() corresponding one. The transparent keyword maps to rgba(0,0,0,0).
rows.label: 계산 값
rows.text: as each of the properties of the shorthand: outline-width: the absolute <length>, snapped as a line width outline-style: as specified outline-color: For the keyword auto, the computed value is currentcolor. For the color value, if the value is translucent, the computed value will be the rgba() corresponding one. If it isn't, it will be the rgb() corresponding one. The transparent keyword maps to rgba(0,0,0,0).
